extraction_notes: Supplementary Table 9 read twice through WebFetch (sample-wise and parameter-wise); both reads agreed on every value. Dose rate units print as 'mGy a-1' in the PDF text layer, which is the micro sign mis-rendered: values are uGy/a (check: 153.1 Gy / 1.265 Gy/ka = 121 ka, matching the printed age). Enamel thickness header prints '(m)', likewise um. Ages: 121 +/- 16, 134 +/- 18, 117 +/- 18 ka printed symmetric; error level (1 or 2 sigma) not confirmed. Program: 'US-ESR ages were modeled using the program by [72] (Shao et al. 2014, Quat. Geochronol. 22:99-106), and updated dose rate conversion factors of [73] (Guerin et al. 2011)'. ESR intensities from T1-B2 peak-to-peak amplitudes on merged signal; X-ray irradiated fragments (Freiberg chamber, 200 um Al foil). The SI PDF text available to WebFetch was truncated near the end (bone U-series section), so later methodological detail could not be checked.
